scope: CVG-001 durable WebAuthn credentials/challenges with tenant-user isolation

criteria.description: PostgreSQL credential state is durable across repository instances and all credential reads, counter updates and deletes require account plus user scope.
criteria.limitations: The proof is repository-local and disposable; it does not certify a target-cluster rollout.

criteria.description: Credential counter advancement is monotonic compare-and-swap, account/user scoped and reports false after a lost race or a repeated/regressing direct update.
criteria.limitations: Full authenticator sign-counter semantics remain part of the separate FIDO2 verifier slice.

criteria.description: Registration and authentication challenges are purpose-specific and durable; PostgreSQL consume is atomic, TTL-bound and single-use, with replay and expiry rejected.
criteria.limitations: Response challenge parsing and binding belong to the full FIDO2 verifier and are deliberately not claimed here.

criteria.description: Both durable tables are ENABLE/FORCE RLS with one tenant policy, runtime ACLs give the API exact access and revoke worker sensitive DML, and repeated reconciliation remains safe.
criteria.limitations: Local database role evidence does not replace target IAM/role validation.

criteria.description: Bootstrap and auth routes use the configured durable repositories and principal account/user scope; local/test doubles remain explicit, while non-local enabled WebAuthn fails closed without durable state or a full FIDO2 verifier.
criteria.limitations: The foundational verifier is intentionally unavailable outside local/test; this is a safety gate, not production WebAuthn acceptance.

criteria.description: TDD and regression evidence is green: intentional RED preceded implementation; focused module/ACL tests pass 23/23, HTTP routes pass 23/23, the PostgreSQL durable-state file passes 2/2 and the full API passes 498/498.
criteria.limitations: Local evidence does not certify remote CI or release environments.

criteria.description: Quality gates pass with official workspace coverage above the required threshold and no migration, OpenAPI, secret, formatting or diff-hygiene failure.
criteria.limitations: Coverage and static checks are workspace-local and do not replace target operations evidence.

criteria.description: Independent review findings were resolved: no P0/P1 remains, the identified direct-repository monotonic P2 was fixed and regression-tested; global ERP non-promotion remains explicit.
criteria.limitations: The final time-boxed sign-off attempt was incomplete; the bounded decision relies on the completed independent review plus direct post-fix tests.

gaps: Full FIDO2 attestation-chain and assertion signature verification, response challenge binding and origin/RP-ID policy remain open and are hard-disabled outside local/test.
This gate does not certify target-cluster migration application, production, providers, remote CI, deployment, backup/restore or release acceptance.
Global Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness and ERP completion remain open; the prior control-plane snapshot remains non-promoting.
conditions: Keep auth_webauthn_credentials and auth_webauthn_challenges tenant/user scoped with FORCE RLS and the least-privilege runtime ACL.
Keep challenge consumption atomic, single-use and TTL-bound, and keep credential counter advancement monotonic CAS.
Do not enable WebAuthn outside local/test until a production-grade FIDO2 verifier is configured and independently verified.
Keep global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
Do not infer target, production, provider, deployment or release acceptance from this local gate.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation and review-driven bounded correction
authority.scope: Durable WebAuthn credential/challenge state, account-user isolation, atomic TTL consumption, runtime wiring, ACL/RLS and non-local fail-closed guard
authority.decision: Authorize bounded local closure of durable state only. Keep full FIDO2 verification, providers, target, production, deployment and release acceptance outside this gate.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before enabling non-local WebAuthn, changing FIDO verification semantics, altering MFA policy, or entering target/production/deployment/release scope.

next_action: Close this bounded task, return to fresh independent scouting and create a new implementation-ready authority before touching the next ERP gap. Do not enable non-local WebAuthn or promote global ERP.
revalidation_triggers: Adding or enabling full FIDO2 attestation/signature verification
Changing challenge binding, MFA enrollment/login policy or credential lifecycle
Changing target, production, provider, deployment, backup/restore or release boundaries
